data_reuse: Every date has already been inspected in earlier studies. All chronological evaluation, selection and walk-forward results are exploratory historical replay, not blind unseen evidence. This is an explicitly requested additional search after experiment 003; the combined search now contains 40 candidates, besides earlier experiments and human design choices.

indicators.common: Row t uses only data through close t. SMA uses complete trailing windows. EMA(span) is adjust=False, seeded with first close. Wilder RMA(n) is seeded by the first n observations' arithmetic mean and then (previous*(n-1)+current)/n. True range is max(H-L,abs(H-previous C),abs(L-previous C)); first TR=H-L. Neutral zero-denominator values are specified below; warmup NaNs do not generate signals. Entry is suppressed wherever an exit condition is also true.
indicators.kama_trend: KAMA(ER10,fast2,slow30): seed mean of first10 closes at row9. At t>=10 ER=abs(Ct-Ct-10)/sum(abs(diff C),last10), zero denominator=>0. SC=(ER*(2/3-2/31)+2/31)^2. KAMA=priorKAMA+SC*(C-priorKAMA). Enter C>KAMA and KAMA>KAMA[t-5] and C>SMA200. Exit C<KAMA or C<SMA200.
indicators.keltner_breakout: Mid=EMA20(C); width=2*RMA20(TR). Enter C>mid+width and C>SMA200. Exit C<mid or C<SMA200.
indicators.adx_directional: Up=H-Hprev,down=Lprev-L. +DM=up if up>down and up>0 else0; -DM=down if down>up and down>0 else0; first DM=0. DI=100*RMA14(DM)/RMA14(TR), zero TR=>0. DX=100*abs(+DI--DI)/(+DI+-DI), zero sum=>0. ADX=RMA14(DX), seeded at first14 available DX. Enter ADX>25 and +DI>-DI and C>SMA200. Exit +DI<-DI or ADX<20 or C<SMA200.
indicators.ichimoku_trend: Tenkan=(highestH9+lowestL9)/2; Kijun=(highestH26+lowestL26)/2. CloudA=((Tenkan+Kijun)/2).shift(26); CloudB=((highestH52+lowestL52)/2).shift(26). Enter C>max(cloudA,cloudB) and Tenkan>Kijun. Exit C<min(cloudA,cloudB) or Tenkan<Kijun. No negative shifts, no lagging-line lookahead.
indicators.aroon_trend: Use trailing26 observations, n=25 intervals. Bars-since most recent highestH and lowestL, ties choose latest. Up=100*(25-ageHigh)/25;Down=100*(25-ageLow)/25. Enter Up>70 and Down<30 and C>SMA200. Exit Up<Down or C<SMA200.
indicators.regression_trend: OLS log(C) on x=0..59 for each trailing60 closes, slope and R2; constant prices=>slope0,R2=0. Enter slope>0 and R2>=0.30 and C>SMA200. Exit slope<=0 or C<SMA100. No significance claim is attached to R2.
indicators.cmo_momentum: CMO20=100*(sum positive diffs20-sum absolute negative diffs20)/sum absolute diffs20; zero total=>0. Enter CMO>30 and C>SMA200. Exit CMO<0 or C<SMA200.
indicators.stochastic_pullback: RawK=100*(C-lowestL14)/(highestH14-lowestL14), zero range=>50. SlowK=SMA3(rawK),D=SMA3(SlowK). Enter SlowK>D and previousSlowK<=previousD and SlowK<30 and C>SMA200. Exit SlowK>80 or C<SMA200 or after10 held daily bars.
indicators.cci_reversion: TP=(H+L+C)/3. CCI20=(TP-mean(TP,last20))/(0.015*mean(abs(each TP in last20 - that window mean))); zero MAD=>0. Enter CCI<-100 and C>SMA200. Exit CCI>=0 or C<SMA200 or after20 held daily bars.
indicators.squeeze_breakout: Width20=4*populationStd20(C)/SMA20(C). Compression[t]=width20[t] <= median of previous120 widths excluding current. Enter at close t when any compression in t-5..t-1 and C>highestH of prior20 bars and C>SMA200. Exit C<SMA20 or C<SMA200.
indicators.obv_breakout: OBV cumulative sign(diff C)*Volume, first increment0; equal closes add0. Enter OBV>highestOBV of prior20 bars and C>highestC of prior20 bars and C>SMA200. Exit OBV<SMA20(OBV) or C<SMA200. Volume is Coinbase-only, not global Bitcoin activity.
indicators.cmf_trend: Multiplier=(2*C-H-L)/(H-L), zero range=>0. CMF20=sum(multiplier*Volume,last20)/sum(Volume,last20), zero volume=>0. Enter CMF>0.10 and C>SMA50 and C>SMA200. Exit CMF<0 or C<SMA50 or C<SMA200. Volume is Coinbase-only.

execution: Reuse frozen experiment003 ledger via its prepared-feature interface; a legacy Candidate only carries sizing, and new features completely replace legacy signals. Close t decisions fill open t+1; flat start; one long position or cash; no leverage/shorting; entry fee included in budget; forced liquidation at final close. Warmup minimum200 prior candles. No intraday fills/order book/partial fill/liquidity model.
allocation: fixed50 spends50% cash per entry. vol15_cap50 spends min(0.5,0.15/(sampleStd of60 daily simple returns*sqrt365.25)), zero volatility=>0.5. Entry only; no rebalancing, drift can exceed50%, achieved volatility not guaranteed15%.
cost_note: Hypothetical bps per side, not actual account fee quotes. Candidates and original_trend100 pay external period-end operating sensitivity120USD/year on initial10000USD; buy/hold and cash benchmarks zero. Taxes excluded. Drawdown is daily close and before external expense in matrix; walk-forward debits expense annually.
selection: NEW24 only: train results under bothbase/stress must be positive after expense, DD<=35%, >=10 closedtrades. Rank stress annualized after-expense return / max(stressDD,1 percentage point), ties lexical ID; none=>cash. Persist train selection before evaluating later dates. Compare legacy16 separately, never silently replace this selector or frozen paper watchlist.
screen: For all NEW24, require positive after expense under base/stress in full,validation,recent; full DD<=35 and >=20 closedtrades; validation>=5 closedtrades. Passing is exploratory historical screen only, not adoption or profit proof. Record every failure.
delay_stress: All NEW24, base/stress, evaluation2024-01-01..2026-10-15, extra signal-feed lags1 and2 days. Shift entry,exit and sizing volatility together so t-close signal fills t+1+lag open. Signals remain state conditions, not queued orders. Holding-period exits still occur10/20 bars after actual entry; terminal liquidation fixed. Record correct original rule dates. These are sensitivity scenarios, not a realistic outage simulator. A delay-robust historical screen adds positive after-expense return and DD<=35 in every delayed scenario; no candidate is added to paper tracking automatically.
walk_forward: NEW24 selector applied on expanding2020..priorDec31 for years2022..2026, final2026 throughOct15. Flat reset annually, carry finalbalance minus operatingexpense, base/stress separate. Cash fallback still pays research expense. Record all240 training runs and10 fold ledgers; no future-dependent tuning.
multiplicity: Conditional maximum-mean centered circular-block bootstrap on base evaluation daily transaction-cost returns across ALL40 (NEW24+legacy16), versuscash andbuy_hold50; blocks10,30,60;2000resamples;seed20261016. Shared date indices. This is not full PBO or correction for previous studies/human choices, excludes operating expense, and is not proof of edge.
diagnostics: Record top-positive-trade concentration, result after subtracting largest positive trade PnL without rerunning equity/sizing, and all yearly mark-to-market returns from full base/stress curves. Trade removal is an attribution diagnostic, not a counterfactual strategy. Audit every matrix, delay, WFA training and fold ledger via independent wealth recurrence.
stop: One fixed matrix. Do not widen/tune parameters after results to manufacture profit. Corrections only for demonstrated defects, with rerun register. Keep all failures. Any further study requires a separately versioned experiment.
